scope: Additional operational acceptance after the frozen validation-only model study; no public deployment or new age-test inference.
selection: Only the paired-seed-qualified VisAgeNet candidate may replace its original slot; ConvNeXt's single-seed optimization remains exploratory.
pipeline_comparison: Use the identical frozen validation inputs and final shared crop/quality policy for baseline and candidate; accepted sample IDs and crop checksums must match exactly.
latency: Measure candidate and baseline sequentially with training idle; no claim from concurrent functional smoke timings. Candidate mean per-method preprocessing/inference may increase at most25% plus2ms for measurement variation.
activation: Prepare a separate artifact bundle, verify all hashes, run the shared-pipeline and CPU/CUDA/API checks, and activate only if every gate passes. Preserve all original and research artifacts.
fallback: Keep the original models active if any model-study or operational gate fails. Record the outcome and measured tradeoffs; no claim of guaranteed accuracy gains.
local_pilot: Pending consented labeled participant photos; this acceptance uses known validation data and does not establish independent camera-domain accuracy.
